changeSet.author: beefcare
changeSet.sql: UPDATE app_user SET terms_accepted = owner_registration_completed, terms_accepted_at = CASE WHEN owner_registration_completed THEN owner_registration_completed_at ELSE NULL END, password_method_status = CASE WHEN password_login_enabled THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE NULL END, password_linked_at = CASE WHEN password_login_enabled THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, google_linked_at = CASE WHEN google_subject IS NOT NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, google_last_used_at = CASE WHEN google_subject IS NOT NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END
